rules.name: Agile
rules.description: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Bounding
rules.description: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

rules.name: Crossing Attack
rules.description: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and roll X dice. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

rules.name: Demolish
rules.description: Ignores Cover, and when attacking units with most models within 1" of terrain, this weapon gets AP(+1).

rules.name: Enhanced Machine-Fog
rules.description: If most models in this unit have Machine-Fog, enemies attacking them always get -1 to hit rolls from Machine-Fog (instead of only when shooting/charging from over 9"/6" away).

rules.name: Enhanced Machine-Fog Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Machine-Fog. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Enhanced Screened
rules.description: If most models in this unit have Screened, enemies attacking them always get -1 to hit rolls from Screened (instead of only when shooting/charging from over 9"/6" away).

rules.name: Grounded Evasion
rules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule has most of them within 1" of terrain, enemies get -1 to hit rolls when attacking them.

rules.name: Hit & Run Shooter
rules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting.

rules.name: Machine-Fog
rules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, enemy units shooting/charging them from over 9"/6" away get -1 to hit rolls .

rules.name: Melee Shrouding
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for charging, that enemy unit gets -2" range to a min. of 6".

rules.name: Melee Shrouding Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Melee Shrouding. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Melee Slayer
rules.description: When charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

rules.name: Mend
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it.

rules.name: Rending
rules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and for each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+4).

rules.name: Rending when Shooting Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Rending on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Screened
rules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, enemy units shooting/charging them from over 9"/6" away get -1 to hit rolls .

rules.name: Teleport
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, you may place this model anywhere fully within 3" of its position when using Advance/Charge actions, or fully within 6" of its position when using Rush actions.

rules.name: Teleport Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Teleport. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Tough
rules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

rules.name: Unpredictable
rules.description: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
rules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Unpredictable Fighter Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unpredictable Fighter. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Versatile Warrior
rules.description: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away, all models with this rule in it either get AP(+1) on their weapons or get +1 to hit rolls.

spells.name: Corrode Weapons
spells.effect: Pick up to two enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which loses AP(1) on its weapons when shooting once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Crushing Force
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 6 hits with AP(2).

spells.name: Cyborg Assault
spells.effect: Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Hit & Run Shooter once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Power Beam
spells.effect: Pick one enemy model within 18" in line of sight, which takes 2 hits with AP(1). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1].

spells.name: Searing Shrapnel
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 4 hits with Demolish.

spells.name: Shrouding Incense
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Enhanced Machine-Fog once (next time the effect would apply).
